name: AmmoGen
teaser: AmmoGen is a server-side framework for SPTarkov that lets anyone create custom ammo, ammo boxes, and loot injections using simple JSON packs, no programming required.
description:
AmmoGen - Custom Ammo Framework

AmmoGen is a server-side framework for SPTarkov that lets anyone create custom ammo, ammo boxes, and loot injections using simple JSON packs, no programming required.

What It Does

  • Loads ammo packs from user/mods/AmmoGen/ammo/
  • Clones existing ammo templates and overrides stats, names, prices, and stack sizes
  • Registers custom ammo with the item database, handbook, and flea market
  • Adds ammo to vanilla traders with optional custom ammo box listings
  • Adds workbench crafting recipes with searchable item requirements
  • Patches magazine and weapon filters so the new ammo fits existing gear
  • Injects custom ammo and boxes into container loot tables
  • Handles all item registration and validation internally

Web Tool

Create ammo packs visually with the AmmoGen Tool — pick a base ammo, tweak stats, configure traders/crafting/loot, and export a ready-to-use zip.

Installation

  1. Drag the SPT folder from the mod archive into your SPT installation directory.
  2. Start the server. AmmoGen loads automatically and waits for ammo packs.

Making an Ammo Pack

  1. Open the AmmoGen Tool.
  2. Select a base ammo template, set your custom stats, name, and description.
  3. Configure traders, crafting, magazine/weapon filters, ammo boxes, and loot as desired.
  4. Click Export to download a zip.
  5. Drag the SPT folder into your SPT install to test (ALWAYS use a new temporary profile when testing).

Tip: Always test on a new developer profile so you can verify trader purchases, crafting, and loot without affecting your main save.

Publishing an Ammo Pack

The AmmoGen Tool export zip is already structured for distribution, users just drag the SPT folder into their install directory.

When publishing:

  1. State the dependency: Your add-on pack requires AmmoGen v2.0.1 for SPT 4.0.13.
  2. Do not include the AmmoGen DLL or other authors’ packs in your zip.
  3. Test by extracting and running the server before publishing.

Dependencies

  • SPTarkov 4.0.13

More Information

View my framework mods and user created add-ons for them here.

See the full documentation, JSON reference, and examples in the GitHub README.
custom_ai_disclosure: I have been programming for 15 years as a hobby, I use AI to draft and create boilerplates, as well as descriptions. The code is thoroughly reviewed by me before anything is published.

versions.description:
v2.3.0 Changelog

  • UI: Raw properties JSON - You can now edit item properties as raw JSON in the tool. The mod will also keep any extra properties that are not shown in the UI, so advanced edits are not lost.
  • Mod Patches - Filters for modded magazines and weapons (Cartridges, Chambers, Camoras all included) are now handled automatically by the mod.
  • Tool UI refresh - Removed the Mod Patches tab. Added Modded Filter Exclusions to the Filters tab, so you can exclude specific modded magazines and weapons from automatic patching.
  • Client: smoke colours + bundle injection - Smoke colour and bundle injection are now combined into a single client plugin. (Make sure to delete the old dll within the “plugins” folder as the new one is inside the “Serenity-AmmoGen” folder in plugins)
  • Server: cleaner logs - Registration and filter patch logs are now condensed into single summary counts instead of listing every item and patched filter.

v2.2.0 Changelog

  • Added new ammo stat fields: buckshotBullets, penetrationPowerDiviation, weight (cartridge weight) and hasGrenaderComponent.
  • Web tool now auto-imports these new stats from the selected base ammo template.
  • Added “Explosion Type” dropdown to compliment hasGrenaderComponent for explosive ammo with the three base-game values.
  • Added client-side bundle injector so custom ammo and ammo box models/icons can be loaded from BepInEx\plugins\Serenity-AmmoGen\bundles.
  • Added opt-in dumpModdedItems config toggle. When enabled, AmmoGen runs after all server mods and writes modded_item_id_dump.json (categorized by Weapons, Magazines, Ammo, Mods, Gear, etc.) for patch authors.
  • Added a new Modded Items tab to the web tool to import modded_item_id_dump.json and filter/search by category with one-click ID copying.
• Fixed an issue where if the tracer colour was set to none (empty in the json) an error would occur on launch, the field is now skipped and the base template settings are used if the field is empty

v2.1.0 Changelog

  • Added custom background color support for ammo, grenades, flares, and ammo boxes via a color picker in the tool.
    • Defaults to default (no override) so base-template colors are preserved.
    • Server applies the chosen color only when a non-default value is set.
  • Added new ammo compatibility patches so custom ammo works correctly with additional weapons and magazines:
    • MTs-255-12
    • Chiappa Rhino 50DS / 200DS
    • RSh-12 revolver
    • Related cylinder/speedloader magazines
  • Added a new Mod Patches tab in the tool for crowd-sourced modded weapon/magazine filter patches.
    • Users can add entries with a mod GUID, name, vanilla ammo IDs, and modded weapon/magazine IDs.
    • Entries are grouped by GUID in collapsible sections.
    • Matching IDs are automatically merged into each ammo’s filters on export.
    • An Apply Mod Patches button is available in the ammo Filters tab.

New weapon support

  • The 12.7x55mm RSh-12 revolver is now automatically patched to accept custom 12.7x55mm ammo. The tool’s auto-detected weapon list and the server-side filter patcher both include it, so your custom rounds load correctly into the revolver’s cylinder slots.

Flea market ban override

  • The Economy tab now has a Flea Banned toggle.
  • When you pick a base ammo template, the toggle is auto-filled from that ammo’s real flea status in the SPT database.
  • You can still flip it on or off manually.
  • The server-side mod now applies this setting when it registers your custom ammo, so it will (or won’t) appear on the flea market exactly as configured.

New features

  • Ammo stats: added many more ammo properties to the mod (projectile, malfunctions, tracer, audio/visual, explosive, light & sound, and area effect stats). The tool now exposes these in the ammo editor with collapsible sections and dropdowns where appropriate.
  • Grenades: added grenades as a second item type, alongside ammo. Supports cloning base grenades, custom explosion/effect/throw stats, smoke/body colors, and smoke settings. The tool has a full grenade editor with matching tabs and a color picker.
  • Flares (WIP): added flares as a third item type. Supports handheld flares and signal pistol cartridges, with custom flare types, colors, and effects. The tool has a flare editor and a WIP banner because the in-game special/handheld slot behavior is still being worked out.

Tool improvements

  • New mode switcher in the header to swap between Ammo, Grenade, and Flare editing.
  • Grenade and Flare editors reuse the existing Economy, Trader, Crafting, and Loot tabs.
  • Color picker for tracer, smoke, body, and flare colors.

NOTE: Grenades or flares with custom emission color require the Color Converter API

• Changed loot tab to allow spawning ammo/ammo box in separate container lists
  • Added toggle for unlimited stock and buy restriction
  • Loot injection is now fixed
  • Added durabilityBurnModificator and ballisticCoeficient

v1.1.0

  • Added WTT Content Backport .308 ME and .308 ME LOKT ammo templates, plus Marlin MXLR rifle/magazine filters.
  • Added the ability to set per-ammo Light Bleeding Delta and Heavy Bleeding Delta stats.
  • Changed the server mod load order to run just before trader registration, allowing AmmoGen to clone modded ammo and patch modded weapon/magazine filters correctly.
  • Added optional ammo box trader overrides (traderId, loyaltyLevel, stockCount, buyRestrictionMax) so an ammo box can use different trader settings than its parent ammo.
  • Added support for stockCount: 0 (unlimited stock) and buyRestrictionMax: 0 (no restriction) for both ammo and ammo boxes.
